title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
author: Martin Kleppmann
short_blurb: A practical guide to designing scalable, reliable, maintainable systems.
long_summary: A deep, practical tour of replication, partitioning, transactions, streams, and the real trade-offs behind modern data systems. It helps you reason about correctness, latency, throughput, and failure modes — the exact things that make pipelines trustworthy in production.

title: Fundamentals of Data Engineering
author: Joe Reis & Matt Housley
short_blurb: A modern overview of the data engineering lifecycle.
long_summary: Frames data engineering as a product discipline: quality, governance, observability, cost, and ownership. Strong for turning ad-hoc pipelines into reliable data products that teams can trust.

title: Clean Code
author: Robert C. Martin
short_blurb: A handbook of agile software craftsmanship.
long_summary: Even in data engineering, unreadable code creates outages. This book pushes naming, structure, testing discipline, and refactoring habits that keep pipelines and services maintainable.

title: The Clean Coder
author: Robert C. Martin
short_blurb: Professionalism, habits, and decision-making under engineering pressure.
long_summary: A guide to professional engineering behavior: saying “no” when needed, communication, estimation, and building trust through consistent execution. Great for growing from "good coder" to dependable engineer.

title: The Data Warehouse Toolkit
author: Ralph Kimball
short_blurb: The definitive guide to dimensional modeling.
long_summary: Explains facts, dimensions, slowly changing dimensions, and patterns that make analytics models understandable and scalable. Still extremely relevant for BI layers and data marts.

title: Kafka: The Definitive Guide
author: Gwen Shapira
short_blurb: Real-time data and stream processing at scale.
long_summary: Covers Kafka architecture, delivery guarantees, and operational practices. Useful for building CDC pipelines, streaming ingestion, and event-driven integrations without fragile coupling.
